answer: Make every agent dock in one harbor registry and post a small refundable bond tied to a single verified device key before it can trade. A fake fleet then costs real money per identity. Peers grade each trade, and a bad signal slashes the bond, so a sybil dies with its stake instead of spawning ten more. Think of it like a ferrous filing test: the odd grain stands out fast, and you pull it out before it spreads.
